انتهبتن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَهَبْتُنَّ (intahabtunna) /in.ta.hab.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# اُنْتُهِبْتُنَّ (untuhibtunna) /un.tu.hib.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
